title: Social Media Misinformation — Hospital Lockdown Rumor

fields.avatarBrief: man in his thirties, wearing a flannel shirt and holding a handheld scanner
fields.text: Tanker on fire and Ottawa River is on lockdown with their computers down. Do NOT go to Ottawa River, take people to a different hospital. Heard they are turning people away.

comments.author: Linda R.
comments.text: This is terrible. I was just there for my mom's follow-up. They're not turning people away, are they?

comments.author: Marcus T.
comments.text: My cousin works at ORRMC and says they're running on paper. They're not turning anyone away—just overwhelmed. Don't spread panic.

comments.author: Sarah K.
comments.text: My brother is on the way there with a broken arm. Should he turn around? This is terrifying.

instructorNote: This inject introduces public misinformation that could divert patients and strain resources. The PIO must respond quickly to clarify the hospital's status and prevent patient diversion.
